title: 第25章 又一张功法卡回村第26章 灵药功法丹药
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 火焰炸开，席卷了周围的一切。
好在吴语第一时间后退，避开了大部分飞溅而出的石块，铁片，还有断肢肉块什么的。
只剩下些许碎块落在金色护罩上。
等火焰散去，吴语才走到近前。
独眼山贼已然成了无头尸体，并未消失。
他看了看四周，被炸死的那些普通山贼已经化光散去了。
看着时不时抽搐一下的无头尸体，吴语也不由得有些咋舌。
很显然，这是仍旧残留有一丝生命力，算不上彻底死亡。
“这还是人么？”
“是超凡生命的特性？还是伥鬼的缘故？”
他拿起砍刀，来自《虎啸八斩刀》的肌肉记忆发挥作用，猛地一刀下去！
伴随着虎啸声响起，刀刃在一丝黑气的缠绕下猛地扎入残尸心口位置。
残尸颤动了一下，好几秒后，一寸寸化光消失。
“大侠用法术杀光了那些山贼！”
“大侠天下无敌！”
“太好了，我活下来了！”
“大侠，麻烦您帮我们松绑。”
看到山贼们死去，村民们也激动起来。
这是一个拥有超凡力量的世界，无论是武者还是法术，都是人们口口相传的东西。
因此见到火焰和白光，众人都认为这是吴语的法术！
吴语没有理会众人，而是将地上的卡片都捡了起来。
两波山贼的，还有独眼山贼头目的。
过程中，他注意了一下众人的反应，发现大部分人都很疑惑，不理解他在干什么。
“看来登塔者与原住民有着本质上的区别。”
“他们可以看到山贼化光消失，却无法看到战利品。”
“而登塔者却能见到！”
“新人秘境是合作类，以后若是有竞争类秘境.....或者说太墟，恐怕会爆发血腥的战斗。”
content_en:
The flames exploded, sweeping away everything around them.
Fortunately, Wu Yu retreated immediately and avoided most of the rocks, pieces of iron, and pieces of broken limbs and flesh that flew out.
Only a few fragments fell on the golden shield.
After the flames dissipated, Wu Yu walked closer.
The one-eyed bandit has turned into a headless corpse and has not disappeared.
He looked around and saw that the ordinary bandits who had been killed in the explosion had turned into light and dispersed.
Looking at the headless corpse that twitched from time to time, Wu Yu couldn't help but be a little speechless.
Obviously, there is still a trace of vitality left, and it is not a complete death.
"Is this still a human being?"
"Is it a characteristic of extraordinary beings? Or is it because of ghosts?"
He picked up the machete, and the muscle memory from "Tiger's Roaring Eight Swords" came into play, and he slashed hard!
roar--!
As the tiger roared, the blade was entangled with a trace of black energy and plunged into the heart of the corpse.
The corpse trembled for a moment, and after a few seconds, it turned into light and disappeared inch by inch.
...
"The hero used magic to kill all those bandits!"
"The hero is invincible!"
"Great, I survived!"
"Hero, please help us loosen our bonds."
...
Seeing the dead bandits, the villagers also became excited.
This is a world with extraordinary power, whether it is warriors or magic, it is something that people pass on word of mouth.
So when they saw the flames and white light, everyone thought it was Wu Yu's magic!
Wu Yu ignored everyone and picked up all the cards on the ground.
Two waves of bandits, as well as the one-eyed bandit leader.
During the process, he paid attention to everyone's reactions and found that most people were confused and didn't understand what he was doing.
"It seems that there is a fundamental difference between the tower climbers and the aboriginal people."
"They can see the bandits turn into light and disappear, but they can't see the loot."
"And those who climb the tower can see it!"
"The newcomer's secret realm is a cooperative one. If there is a competitive secret realm in the future... or Taixu, I'm afraid a bloody battle will break out."
